purpose: Questions outside the existing 20-case live benchmark, used to assess registry-independent official-source discovery. Results require manual substantive and claim-level review.

cases.workflow: Individual employment income / cross-border / double taxation relief
cases.question: If a Singapore tax resident earns employment income while physically working overseas on a temporary secondment, under what conditions is that foreign-sourced income taxable in Singapore or eligible for double taxation relief?
I am an individual living in Singapore and received interest from a bank account overseas. When would Singapore tax that interest, and what facts should I check?
What must a Singapore employer do for tax when a foreign employee is leaving Singapore permanently, and when may the employer release the employee's final pay?

cases.workflow: Corporate tax / withholding tax / cross-border services
cases.question: A Singapore company pays an overseas consultant for work partly performed in Singapore and partly performed abroad. When could withholding tax apply, and what details determine the amount or exemption?
A Singapore GST-registered business buys cloud hosting from a foreign supplier. When does reverse charge apply, and how does full input tax recovery affect the outcome?
When does a Singapore company have to file its Estimated Chargeable Income after its financial year end, and what exemptions or filing conditions should it check?
How does IRAS determine whether an employee who spends part of the year in Singapore is a Singapore tax resident, and which dates or employment arrangements matter?
A Singapore company remits profits from an overseas branch into Singapore. What conditions determine whether those branch profits are exempt or taxable here?
If the same employment income is taxed in Singapore and the country where I worked, how do I check whether a tax treaty or foreign tax credit can relieve the double tax?
Can an employee claim personal tax relief for professional course fees paid during the year, and what conditions and exclusions apply?
